# The Craftsman Blog

> > A comprehensive resource for historic home restoration, old house repair, and heritage preservation led by expert contractor Scott Sidler.

The Craftsman Blog is dedicated to helping homeowners and DIY enthusiasts restore and maintain historic properties. Founded by Scott Sidler, a state-licensed residential contractor and Amazon bestselling author, the site combines expert knowledge with practical guidance for old house restoration across regions including Florida, Georgia, New York, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Historic Restoration
- Old House Repair
- DIY Home Improvement
- Heritage Preservation
